goal: Run independent agent attempts, gate review until all attempts finish, compare candidates, retain the strongest result, and preserve failures and lessons.
selectedApproach: Mission DAG dependencies plus BenchmarkArena weighted scoring
whyItWon: Correctness and robustness dominate the score while latency and resource use still break close contests. Review missions cannot run before all independent attempts complete.

rejectedAttempt.failure: A faster, lower-resource candidate beat a materially more correct candidate in the benchmark fixture.
rejectedAttempt.lesson: For DIG reliability work, speed and resource use must not outweigh correctness when the quality gap is meaningful.

remainingGates: atomic multi-process or multi-VM claim semantics
